metadata.description: RepoMan: automated repo-maintenance programs across enrolled GitHub repos

plugins.name: link-health
plugins.description: Scan and fix broken links across all repos in a GitHub org

plugins.name: dep-bump
plugins.description: Monitor and analyze Dependabot PRs for SLA breaches across a GitHub org

plugins.name: automation-health
plugins.description: Generate executive-facing automation health dashboard combining all program metrics

plugins.name: github-weekly-report
plugins.description: Generate comprehensive weekly GitHub org activity reports with active-epic tracking

plugins.name: github-pr-review
plugins.description: Automated PR review — conventions, security, CI status, inline comments

plugins.name: repo-sync
plugins.description: Keep local clones of the enrolled repos current by cloning missing ones and fast-forward pulling the rest, read-only toward GitHub

plugins.name: doc-drift
plugins.description: Detect documentation drift against a pinned git boundary and draft Keep a Changelog notes from merged PRs

plugins.name: repoman
plugins.description: The RepoMan entrypoint: first-time setup, enabling a program, enrolling repos or an org, or running a program across enrolled repos. A single intent-dispatching skill.
